info.title: JobPilot Candidate API
info.description: The candidate surface of /api/v1 (Stage 14, ADR-0013, ADR-0028): recommendations, job detail, match analysis, applications and the folder, interviews, notifications, the profile summary, the analytics summary and the ATS ruleset lookup. Authenticated by API key (Bearer). Every error is the structured envelope. This document is FROZEN: docs/api/openapi.candidate.v1.lock records its hash and a test fails when they disagree; a breaking change is version 2, never an edit. No operation submits an application without the applicant's own instruction (ADR-0016).

apiKey.description: A JobPilot API key (jp_live_... or jp_test_...). Scopes: read for every GET; apply:write for the two POSTs.

applicationMode.description: Approved Auto-Apply is not a value this field can hold (ADR-0016).

atsSubmittable.description: True only when the employer has authorised a programmatic submission AND the applicant's mode permits it; the POST .../submit is refused otherwise.

value.description: Always empty when decision is never.
